dedupe_keys.name: water corporation western australia dam levels rainfall streamflow and water use

description: Water Corporation, the water utility of Western Australia, publishes a rainfall and dams section with pages on rainfall, dam levels, streamflow, water use, Perth's water supply, groundwater, desalination and wastewater. The overview updated on 24 September 2026 showed September streamflow into the dams (3.98 GL), water used the previous day (858 ML), Perth metro dam levels and Perth rainfall against the monthly average for 1876 to 2016. Dam volumes, rainfall and water use are updated every working day and streamflow weekly. Coverage is the dams of the Perth metropolitan area and the Integrated Water Supply Scheme, which also serves the Goldfields, the Agricultural Region and parts of the South West. Access is online and free on the utility website. Caveats: the pages show current values and charts, not downloads, historical rainfall is referred to the Bureau of Meteorology, and dams now also store groundwater and desalinated water, so storage is not only natural inflow. Simulation uses: storage, inflow and demand series for supply planning under a drying climate. Related records: Hong Kong reservoir data (data-hong-kong-wsd-open-data-reservoirs-supply-bursts) and South African dam volumes (data-mzansi-amanzi-south-africa-monthly-surface-water-dam-volumes).
